alignments.note: Waw of the consecutive form takes the ASV's And (rule 14).

Presentative הָיָה takes the whole frame it came to pass together with the frame's complementizer that (rules 21, 45); the apodosis writes no waw of its own, so the that stays with the verb. Discontinuous around the date phrase under rule 25.

The compound numeral עַשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵה is rendered by the single English word eleventh, so the one-English-word condition of rule 30 is met and the two morphemes share one indivisible unit, headed on the numeral's lemma-bearing first token.
No article morpheme stands in the phrase, so the supplied the belongs to the nominal expression it determines (rule 15).
The numeral is rendered by the phrase the first day; day* is the noun the ASV supplies to complete the phrase and the supplied the determines it (rules 31, 15), so the head stays on first.
לְ rendered by of before the month (rule 11).
Assimilated article supplied by MACULA takes the written the (rule 12).
Construct noun; the rectum is an anarthrous proper name, so the single written the is a supplied one standing before the construct (rule 29).
Nomen rectum takes the relational of (rule 19), headed on the name.
Finite הָיָה of the message formula → came.
The לְ of לֵאמֹר has no English realization (rule 27).

review_notes: The verse's one contested edge is the frame's that (t017): rule 45 assigns it to the presentative הָיָה because the apodosis opens with no waw of its own.
Both supplied the's (t007, t011) are placed on the nominal expressions they determine, no article morpheme being present in either date phrase.
